name: monorepo-template

scripts.seed: bun scripts/seed-test-users.ts && bun scripts/seed-second-household.ts && bun scripts/seed-e2e-approval-fixtures.ts
scripts.g: sh -c 'git add . && git status && git commit -m "$1" && git push' _

// patchedDependencies: Source repo patches expo-constants, expo-updates, and @sentry/react-native via patchedDependencies + patches/*.patch (workarounds for specific Expo/Sentry bugs at specific versions). Evaluated 2026-08-06 against this template's pinned versions (expo-constants ~57.0.2, expo-updates ~57.0.5, @sentry/react-native ~7.11.0): the original bugs did not reproduce, and apps/mobile builds/runs clean without them, so no patches were carried over. Reintroduce patchedDependencies only if the same bugs resurface at these (or later) pinned versions.

lint-staged.//: Scoped to code dirs on purpose: docs/** is biome-ignored anyway. (Historical note, D16: docs/templates/biome.json — the copy-paste teaching file — used to be a conflicting nested ROOT config under Biome 2.x's tree-wide config discovery, which ignores don't stop; it's since been renamed to docs/templates/biome.json.template so Biome no longer discovers it as a config at all, which is what actually unbroke `bun run format`/`format:check` at the root, not this scoping.)
